components.title: Filter orders by date range
components.what: Select orders with order_date between 2026-05-09 and 2026-06-14 inclusive, regardless of status.

components.title: List unit prices
components.what: Extract the unit_price values from the filtered order list.

components.title: Compute median
components.what: Sort the unit_price list and compute the median value, averaging the two middle values if the count is even.

components.title: Round and report
components.what: Round the median to two decimal places and present it as the final answer.
